card.name: Early pieces of drug names
card.fires_on: The first or second piece of a drug name that is split into parts, such as the 'up' in Bupivacaine or the 'ton' in Etonogestrel. It appears in drug-label text where a brand or generic name is being written out.

modes.label: Local anesthetic names
modes.description: Opening pieces of anesthetic names like bupivacaine and mepivacaine.

modes.label: Other generic drug names
modes.description: Early pieces of other generic names such as etonogestrel, idelalisib, adapalene or famotidine.
